$comment: Authoritative instrument registry for verifiers/check_assertion_floors.py (round-37 claim C2a, scout M7's HIGH). The guard's two in-file tables (EXPECTED_INSTRUMENTS, INSTRUMENTS) agree with each other by construction, so a coordinated edit -- the same row deleted from BOTH, a floor lowered in BOTH, a row path repointed -- was self-consistent and silent: the instrument stopped rerunning while the guard still printed all-PASS (scout M7, round 35; re-probed at 041f6ba by seat P5). This file is the anchor OUTSIDE the edited file: any disagreement fails loudly before a self-test runs, naming the class. BUMP-IN-STEP RULE: when a row's floor moves, edit this file, both in-file tables and the guard docstring in the same change; a half-bump now fails loudly on the side that was missed. TRUST BOUNDARY (documented, not enforced): a coordinated edit of this anchor as well is a three-artifact edit and out of scope for this guard; --script NAME=PATH stays an explicit operator override by design.
